lines.3: You don't just decide on a dream and--presto--achieve it.
lines.5: Nearly everyone eventually runs into a wall.
lines.6: I'm still a student, so studying hasn't been too painful for me yet.
lines.7: After graduating from Ryuumeikan, Nagomi began training as an apprentice chef.
lines.9: 「You're completely wiped out every day, Nagomi.」
lines.10: Kitchen work has left her beautiful hands rough and chapped.
lines.11: I wrap my hands around her cold ones.
lines.14: 「How is it on the job? As rough as you expected?」
lines.15: 「...It's infuriating. They yell at me constantly.」
lines.16: 「And the more exhausted I get, the louder this voice inside me becomes.」
lines.17: 「Maybe you're not cut out for this... Admit it already... You've done enough. Take a day off for once...」
lines.18: 「It says all sorts of things. I suppose you'd call it the voice of weakness.」
lines.19: 「That voice may be a bigger problem than all the shouting at work.」
lines.22: 「What matters is what you do with it.」
lines.23: 「So what do you want from me? Should I tell you to take it easy for a while?」
lines.28: 「And you call that fragile? You're plenty strong.」
lines.30: 「Haha. I wonder how everyone else is doing...」
lines.34: 「How did that traveling performance go the other day?」
lines.35: 「Oh, it went pretty well. But there were people obviously way above my level, so that got me a little down.」
lines.36: 「Well, I like your music. When the student council first recruited me outside the school gates, I thought you were kind of weird, though.」
lines.38: 「...I've still got a long way to go, but people keep coming to hear me like this. Maybe I'm finally making some progress.」
lines.39: 「Let's see, China tomorrow evening. Haneda at three.」
lines.40: 「Ellie, we have the party with our partner company before that.」
lines.42: 「Of course. I'll rub your shoulders too. You're always working so hard.」
lines.43: 「Sorry I make you juggle such a packed schedule too.」
lines.44: 「It's all right. You can give me all the trouble you like.」
lines.47: 「All right! Down with the Mashu conglomerate! Let's go!」
lines.50: 「Good grief. Is getting serious about track this late really going to change anything...?」
lines.51: 「I can't catch the people ahead, and the people behind are about to pass me... Guess that's the price of slacking off.」
lines.52: 「Well, I'll keep running as far as I can.」
lines.53: 「And that is why I designed this game: Doso-Koi!」
lines.54: 「A pretty-boy sumo ADV set in the world of sumo! Our love has no holds barred! My love for you is on the edge of the ring!」
lines.55: 「Nobody's touched this genre yet. We'll fill it with every kind of hot guy and plunder the fanatics' wallets!」
lines.57: 「Yes, most of them are! But they still wear mawashi! We'll introduce a chanko hospitality system!」
lines.60: 「Still, I'm this close to getting a proposal approved at this major company! I won't give up!」
lines.61: 「...They bullied you again? Other people's cruelty is painful.」
lines.63: 「Teacher, more than that, I want to become strong... Even if you talk to them, I'm the one who has to deal with this in the end.」
lines.64: 「I see. Well said! Then I'll train you myself.」
lines.66: I can almost picture everyone out there doing their best.
lines.67: 「They're a tough bunch. I'm sure they're all doing fine.」
lines.69: I can't reach out and help them, but I'm cheering for them.
